title: Take a Moment (Naked  (F4F))
description: Take a moment to yourself, and listen intently, as I take you down a winding path into trance. In this session, once I am deeply inside your waking mind, I will have you turn your senses inwards. Blanking your thoughts — I'll have you pull up an inner avatar, a bound up you, whose mind I take you into. Before blanking that other you as well. Binding that other mind's thoughts — only to start again — forming yet another bound up you. Binding that one as well. And each time we go into another bound up you, your mind goes deeper, my control penetrates further. So that, once I am past every defence your mind has to offer, I can install a deep trigger to help you deal with stressful situations. To help you take a moment and relax when you need to. To build you up and make you better.
author: Mistress Shibby
